limits: Scheduled supply only: the BMTC GTFS is unofficial (Vonter, scraped from the Namma BMTC app, known timetable errors, only routes with live tracking), as of 8 Sep 2026.
OSM walking network completeness is unknown: unmapped footpaths shorten catchments, and population in cells with no mapped walkway counts as uncovered.
WorldPop 2025 is a modelled estimate at 1 km; coverage inside a cell is assumed proportional to covered walkable length.
Stops outside the district boundary are not used, which can under-count coverage near the edge.
Access only: no frequency threshold, crowding, fares or safety is assessed.
